Subscription prices can be changed at any time, but a price increase only applies to new subscribers — existing subscribers keep their current price until they resubscribe.
If I raise my price, does it affect people already subscribed?
Based on the platform's pricing FAQ, no — a price increase only applies to new subscribers. Anyone already subscribed keeps their current price until they resubscribe.
